Usage: etos query [OPTIONS] <TEXT>

Arguments:
  <TEXT>  The SQL text (GraphQL with --graphql); `-` reads it from stdin

Options:
      --graphql          Interpret the text as GraphQL
      --json             Print the result as JSON, for scripts
      --fresh            Bypass the cache
      --task <ID>        On the node host: the task the command concerns
      --name <NAME>      Name of the result file under /rg/queries/
      --format <FORMAT>  Result format: md, csv or jsonl (chosen by size when absent)
  -h, --help             Print help

Examples:
  etos query "select id, total from \"order\" where status = 'paid' limit 20"
  etos query --graphql '{ customer(id: "c_1") { orders { id } } }'
  etos query --name paid --format csv "select * from \"order\""
